title:
Epic triggered on `BUTTON_CLICK` actions to display modals based on the permission
assigned to {@link ReliabilityMetric} while creating a the metric.
If `permission` is `Public` and there are `childMetrics` associated with the `expression`,
then we will show a modal to promote all the private metrics.
If the `permission` is `Private` user will directed to the `ReviewAndConfirm` modal.
name: ShowPromoteOrSaveModalEpic
